posts.text:
Poverty isn’t an invention. It’s natural. It was the natural human condition everywhere in the world for hundreds of thousands of years. The average human being for thousands of generations lived on no more than a few dollars per day. 

What is an invention? Wealth. Prosperity. And it wasn’t created by socialism.
posts.summary: Argues prosperity and wealth are human innovations, not natural condition
